_texte.Accepți sau refuzi comanda: You accept or decline the order
_texte.Adaugi sau elimini angajați, le actualiz: You add or remove employees, update their certifications and assign them job types. Each employee has their own access to the partner app.

_texte.Aliniat catalogului My Darrin. Bifează e: Aligned with the My Darrin catalog. Tick exactly what you can carry out — Maintenance, Replacement, Repair, Installation.
_texte.Cei 8 pași de onboarding (date firmă, NA: The 8 onboarding steps (company details, NACE, employees, certifications, area) are completed in the web or mobile app after registration.
_texte.CMR digital + PV recepție generate autom: Digital CMR + acceptance report generated automatically. The pro forma invoice becomes a tax invoice when the customer confirms.
_texte.Completezi formularul complet în aplicaț: You complete the full form in the app
_texte.Configurabil și din backoffice: Also configurable in the back office
_texte.Configurezi canalele de notificare (push: You set up the notification channels (push, email, SMS) and urgent alerts. You decide which types of orders you want to receive in real time.
_texte.Darrin AI te alocă pe comenzile care se: Darrin AI assigns you to orders that match your skills, area and availability — without you having to look for customers.
_texte.Darrin AI îți trimite comanda direct în: Darrin AI sends you the order straight in the mobile app, with all the details: customer address, service requested, materials needed, proposed time and amount allocated.
_texte.De ce My Darrin e partenerul ideal: Why My Darrin is the ideal partner
_texte.Din aplicație, accepți comanda cu un sin: In the app, you accept the order with a single tap. If you can't, you decline it with a reason. Accepted orders go into your calendar with the booking confirmed.
_texte.Disponibil pentru urgențe, oricând (incl: Available for urgent jobs, any time (including nights and weekends)
_texte.Execuți lucrarea conform devizului: You carry out the work according to the quote
_texte.Execuți lucrarea conform specificațiilor: You carry out the work according to the order specifications. The materials have already been delivered by the My Darrin supplier before you arrive. The order status is updated in real time in the customer's dashboard.
_texte.Factura fiscală, CMR digital, PV recepți: Tax invoice, digital CMR, acceptance report with photos — all generated from the app. You sign digitally and don't waste time on paperwork.
_texte.Fiecare comandă vine cu poliță de asigur: Every order comes with a damage/workmanship insurance policy. You are protected towards the customer, at no extra cost.
_texte.Gestionezi comenzile, confirmările, foto: You manage orders, confirmations, report photos and payment history from a single app. Available on iOS & Android.
_texte.Ghid complet: cum devii partener My Darr: Complete guide: how to become a My Darrin partner — registration, verification and first orders.
_texte.Intervențiile de noapte și sărbători au: Night and holiday call-outs have rates configured separately in the back office. You earn more for extended availability.
_texte.Istoricul complet al plăților, facturilo: Full history of payments, invoices issued and transfers received. Export for accounting available in CSV/PDF format.
_texte.La finalizare, fotografiezi rezultatul (: On completion, you photograph the result (After) and mark the order as complete. The system notifies the customer automatically by email and SMS. The photos are stored for the duration of the warranty.
_texte.La sosire, fotografiezi starea inițială: On arrival, you photograph the initial condition (Before) directly from the app. The photos are geolocated and time-stamped automatically — they cannot be changed afterwards. They are your proof and the platform's.
_texte.Monitorizezi ratingul tău public și răsp: You monitor your public rating and reply to reviews. The rating directly affects your priority in the matching algorithm.
_texte.Rata de acceptare influențează scorul tă: Your acceptance rate affects your score in the matching algorithm. A high score = more orders allocated automatically.
_texte.Selectezi serviciile pe care le oferi, z: You select the services you offer, your coverage area and availability. Darrin AI does the rest — automatic orders, guaranteed payments, zero red tape.
_texte.Suma e blocată pe cardul clientului înai: The amount is held on the customer's card before you start. There's no risk of non-payment. The transfer is automatic on completion.
_texte.Suma pe care ai acceptat-o la confirmare: The amount you accepted when confirming the order is yours
_texte.Tarifele pentru urgențe (noapte, sărbăto: Urgent rates (night, holidays) are configured separately in the back office and shown automatically to the customer when ordering.
_texte.Tot ce ai nevoie să știi despre fluxul z: Everything you need to know about the daily flow — from receiving the order to getting paid.
_texte.Tot ce gestionezi din dashboard: Everything you manage from the dashboard
_texte.Totul se sincronizează cu catalogul My D: Everything syncs with the My Darrin catalog. The AI algorithm only assigns you to the services you've confirmed you provide.
_texte.Vizualizezi toate comenzile confirmate p: You see all confirmed orders on the calendar. You change your availability, urgent hours and active areas any time from the app.
_texte.Vizualizezi toate garanțiile active, ter: You see all active warranties, expiry dates and any complaints. You manage warranty call-outs directly from the dashboard.
